meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 在本地启动网页版仪表盘,把当前项目已有的知识图谱显示在浏览器里,并返回一条带访问令牌的网址;若项目还没有图谱,只提示先运行 /understand。
howto.when: 当你说“打开/查看项目知识图谱仪表盘”这类要求时触发;只有项目里已有 /understand 生成的知识图谱时才会成功,否则只是提示先分析。

say.text: 启动当前项目的知识图谱仪表盘
say.note: 会在后台启动服务,并在浏览器打开图谱页面。

say.text: 打开 /home/me/myproject 的知识图谱仪表盘
say.note: 会以该目录已有的知识图谱文件来启动服务。

howto.what_en: Starts a local web dashboard that shows the project's existing knowledge graph in the browser, and returns a URL with an access token. If no graph exists, only asks the user to run /understand first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to open or view the dashboard for a project's knowledge graph. It only succeeds when the project already has a knowledge graph from /understand; otherwise it tells the user to analyze first.

say_en.text: Start the knowledge-graph dashboard for this project.
say_en.note: It starts the service in the background and opens the graph page.
It starts the service using that directory's existing graph file.
